title: AssetCat: a free and open source tool to search and browse game asset packs
author: digitalhobbit
selftext:
For context: I'm currently building some games with Claude Code and wanted to try using one of the hundreds of asset packs I've collected over the past decade (mostly from Humble Bundle, but also the excellent Kenney all-in-one pack). But with \~100 GB of assets, navigating the asset library to find the right asset is surprisingly painful.

So I figured I'd build a tool to index, browse, and search my collection, as well as easily pull assets into my game (including a CLI tool and Claude Code skill to let it search and pull from the collection).

After a simple indexing pass, you can browse, search, and preview (including 3D and sounds) your assets in the web UI. An optional classification pass using local AI models enables meaning based search (e.g. finding images of a person wielding a sword even if the file is called something like "tile\_1234.png").

A bunch of people on social media suggested that I share it, so I added some features, polish, and open sourced it on Github. MIT license, so do whatever you want with it. Hope it's useful to others as well. Let me know (here or via a Github issue) if you have any feedback or feature requests.

[https://github.com/digitalhobbit/assetcat](https://github.com/digitalhobbit/assetcat)
